faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER), Puducherry, for an ICMR-funded research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by JIPMER?
faq.answer: JIPMER has advertised for the post of Project Technical Support – III under an ICMR-funded project scheme bearing the advertisement number JIP/EM&T/F-MA/ICMR-INDIA EMS Project/2026/N03H.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Technical Support – III post on a contractual basis as specified in the recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MPH (Master’s of Public Health) degree along with a good command over Tamil and English languages for speaking, reading, and writing.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying to the Project Technical Support – III post is up to 35 years as per the guidelines of the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary or monthly stipend offered?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Technical Support – III post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 33,600/- per month, which includes Rs. 28,000/- plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for sending complete applications along with required scanned documents via email is 14-10-2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for JIPMER recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via email. Candidates need to email their filled application form and supporting documents to [email protected].

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a written test assessing knowledge in quantitative & qualitative research, epidemiology, and bio-statistics, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where should I email my completed application?
faq.answer: You should email your filled application form along with your CV and supporting documents scanned into a single PDF file to [email protected].
